User Data Protection & Privacy

Privacy Policy

Last Updated: November 4, 2026·Global Standard Compliance
01

Information We Collect

We collect information you provide directly to us when you submit a prompt, use our contact form, or sign up for our newsletter. This includes your name, email address, and the contents of your message.

We also automatically collect standard usage analytics, including browser type, device type, IP address, and pages visited, to ensure the site functions correctly, eliminate layout errors, and understand user behavior.

02

Advertising, Cookies & Tracking

This site relies on advertising revenue to remain free. Third-party vendors, including Google, use cookies and web beacons to serve ads based on a user's prior visits to this website or other websites on the internet.

These advertising cookies enable our partners to serve personalized advertisements to you based on your browsing history. You may opt out of personalized advertising by visiting the applicable ad network's settings (such as Google Ads Settings or the Network Advertising Initiative opt-out page).

03

How We Use Your Information

We use the information we collect to:

  • Operate, maintain, and continuously improve the Website design and features.
  • Respond directly to your prompt engineering questions and technical support requests.
  • Track the popularity of specific AI prompt formulas to expand our curated library.
  • Monitor against fraudulent activity, spam, or automated bot scraping.
04

Data Sharing and AI Training

We respect your privacy. We do not sell, trade, or rent your personally identifiable information to third parties.

Furthermore, the search queries and direct interactions you have on GetYourAIPrompt are used strictly for our own web analytics and are not sold to data brokers.

05

Data Retention and Security

We retain personal correspondence from contact inquiries only as long as necessary to address your request. We employ industry-standard encryption, SSL/TLS data transfer protocols, and secure cloud storage to protect your submissions against unauthorized access or tampering.

06

Contact Us

If you have questions, feedback, or data requests regarding this Privacy Policy, please contact our team via our Contact Form or email us directly at privacy@getyouraiprompt.com.
